sn35.234:1.1: Ekaṃ samayam āyasmā ca Ānando āyasmā ca Udāyī Kosambiyaṃ viharanti Ghositārāme || || 2
sn35.234:1.2: Atha kho āyasmā Udāyī sāyaṇhasamayam paṭisallāṇā vuṭṭhito yenāyasmā Ānando tenupasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā-
sn35.234:1.3: -vītisāretvā ekam antaṃ nisīdi || || 3 Ekam antaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā Udāyī āyasmantam Ānandam etad avoca ||
sn35.234:2.1: Yatheva nu kho āvuso Ānanda ayaṃ kāyo Bhagavatā anekapariyāyena akkhāto vivaṭo pakāsito
sn35.234:2.2: iti pi ayaṃ kāyo anattāti || sakkā evam evaṃ viññāṇam pidam ācikkhituṃ desetum paññāpetum paṭṭhapetuṃ vivarituṃ vibhajituṃ uttānīkātum iti pidaṃ viññāṇam anattā ti || ||
sn35.234:3.1: Yatheva kho āvuso Udāyi ayaṃ kāyo Bhagavatā anekapariyāyena akkhāto vivaṭo pakāsito
sn35.234:3.2: iti pāyam kāyo anattāti || sakkā evam evaṃ viññāṇam pi ācikkhituṃ desetuṃ paññāpetum paṭṭhapetum vivarituṃ vibhajitum uttānīkātum || iti pidaṃ viññāṇam anattāti || || 4-6
sn35.234:4.1: Cakkhuñca āvuso paṭicca rūpe ca uppajjati cakkhuviññāṇanti || ||
sn35.234:4.3: Yo cāvuso hetu yo ca paccayo cakkhuviññāṇassa uppādāya so ca hetu so ca paccayo sabbena sabbaṃ sabbathā sabbam apariseso nirujjheyya api nu kho cakkhuviññāṇam paññāyethāti || ||
sn35.234:4.5: Iminā pi kho etam āvuso pariyāyena Bhagavatā akkhātaṃ vivaṭam pakāsitam iti pidaṃ viññāṇam anattā ti || pa || || 7-8
sn35.234:5.1: Jivhañcāvuso paṭicca rase ca uppajjati jivhāviññāṇanti || ||
sn35.234:5.3: Yo cāvuso hetu yo ca paccayo jivhāviññāṇassa uppādāya so ca hetu so ca paccayo sabbena sabbaṃ sabbathā sabbam apariseso nirujjheyya api nu kho jivhāviññāṇam paññāyethā ti || ||
sn35.234:5.5: Iminā pi kho etam āvuso pariyāyena Bhagavatā akkhātaṃ vivaṭam pakāsitam iti pidaṃ viññāṇam anattā ti || pa || || 9
sn35.234:6.1: Manañcāvuso paṭicca dhamme ca uppajjati manoviññāṇanti || ||
sn35.234:6.3: Yo cāvuso hetu yo ca paccayo manoviññāṇassa uppādāya || so ca hetu so ca paccayo sabbena sabbaṃ sabbathā sabbam apariseso nirujjheyya api nu kho manoviññāṇam paññāyethāti || ||
sn35.234:6.5: Iminā pi kho etam āvuso pariyāyena Bhagavatā akkhātaṃ vivaṭam pakāsitam iti pidaṃ viññāṇam anattā ti || || 10
sn35.234:7.1: Seyyathāpi āvuso puriso sāratthiko sāragavesī sārapariyesanaṃ caramāno tiṇham kuṭhārim ādāya vanam paviseyya || so tattha passeyya mahantaṃ kadalikkhandhaṃ ujuṃ navakam akukkukajātaṃ || tam evam mūle chindeyya || mūle chetvā agge chindeyya || agge chetvā pattavaṭṭiṃ vinibbhujjeyya || || So tattha pheggum nādhigaccheyya kuto sāram || || 11
sn35.234:7.2: Evam eva kho āvuso bhikkhu chasu phassāyatanesu nevattānaṃ na attaniyaṃ samanupassati ||
sn35.234:7.3: so evam asamanupassanto na kiñci loke upādiyati ||
sn35.234:7.4: anupādiyaṃ na paritassati || aparitassaṃ paccattaṃ neva parinibbāyati ||
sn35.234:7.5: Khīnā jāti vusitam brahmacariyaṃ kataṃ karanīyaṃ nāparam itthattāyāti pajānātīti || || 1
